description: Bare parens in nu interpolated strings are subexpressions: prose parens like (fabro-1a41, guards investigation) parse as list syntax and crash at runtime (Command not found); nu --ide-check is blind to this class. Escape literal parens or keep them out of $-strings. lint-nu bare-paren-check (fabro bffd0ce43) is the detector; positive and negative validated 2026-09-28.
resolution: Escape parens in $-strings; lint-nu bare-paren-check gates every repo script.

description: nu 0.115 boolean + path self traps: (1) multi-line boolean expressions cannot start or continue a line with or/and — 'a\nor b' parses as command 'or', trailing 'or' gives incomplete-math-expression; build booleans as [.prefix1 .prefix2] | any {|q|  | str starts-with } then one single-line or, or single-line parenthesized chains. (2) path self is PARSE-TIME only: const X = (path self | ...) works, runtime let fails with 'this command can only run during parse-time' — pair a parse-time const SCRIPT_DIR with runtime joins for re-invocation paths, and path-expand before cd.
resolution: Applied in scripts/qualitygate.nu loop-asset?/product-denied?, .fabro/workflows/loop/scripts/*, run-scope-fixtures (fabro-70b5 session 2026-09-30)

description: nu glob path-form pitfall: absolute vs relative results break literal-list matching
resolution: normalize glob results with `path relative-to $env.PWD` before comparing against repo-relative literals; keep one normalization point
